Hi Michael — thanks for the clear note. Quick answers below and a short proposal attached. Happy to walk through on a call.

Summary (high level):
- Committed plan: you pick a committed throughput (tokens/min or requests/min) and a monthly committed spend.
- Burst handling: short bursts are accommodated via a configurable burst window. By default we allow bursts up to 3x committed throughput for up to 30 minutes/day. Bursts beyond that incur overage charges.
- Overage pricing: overrun usage is billed at a defined overage rate (we typically price overages ~1.6–2.0x the committed unit rate, depending on discount).
- True-up cadence: monthly true-ups that appear as a line item on the next invoice (we can also do quarterly true-ups on larger contracts).
- Temporary rate-limit increases: we can enable temporary rate-limit bumps (30–72 hour windows) via an ops request; for launches we can pre-authorize up to X bursts/month in the SOW.

Attachments: commit-transition-proposal.pdf (proposed committed tiers + expected unit economics), burst-policy-summary.pdf (guardrails and recommended SLOs).

Proposed next step: 30 min call Mon or Tue to confirm commit size and billing cadence. Suggesting Mon 10am PT.
